description: This file defines the SubpanelMetaDataParser class, which extends ListLayoutMetaDataParser to handle subpanel layout metadata in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for constructing the parser, retrieving default fields, handling save operations, and formatting related fields as links.

classes.name: SubpanelMetaDataParser
classes.description: A PHP class that manages parsing and editing subpanel layout metadata for SuiteCRM, extending ListLayoutMetaDataParser and including methods for retrieving default fields, saving layout, and formatting relate fields as links.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser object, loads view definitions and field definitions, and identifies invisible fields, based on subpanel, module, and package names.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current layout, optionally populating data from request, updating labels, and deploying the modified view definitions.

methods.name: getDefaultFields
methods.description: Returns a list of default fields for the subpanel layout, filtering out 'query_only' usage fields.

methods.name: findInvisibleFields
methods.description: Identifies fields marked as 'query_only' in the view definitions, indicating they are invisible but used in the MVC layer.

methods.name: restoreInvisibleFields
methods.description: Restores invisible fields into the view definitions before saving.

methods.name: _trimFieldDefs
methods.description: Static method that trims field definitions, converting 'label' to 'vname' for consistency.

methods.name: makeRelateFieldsAsLink
methods.description: Formats relate fields as links in the subpanel by setting widget_class and target module/record keys.
